doc: A 64x32 perturbed coarse grid upsampled to 4096x2048 (8.4M texels): the function works in bands of 4194304 // width = 1024 rows, so the target is processed in 2 bands; the result must not depend on the banding. The case stores 8 full rows (0, 1, 511, the last row of band 0 and the first and second row of band 1, and the last two rows) and the sum over the columns of EVERY row (3 components: a fingerprint of all 2048 rows) instead of the 100 MB map. Measured: the rows differ by 3e-8 from the float64 pipeline without its final rounding and by 6.6e-6 from a pipeline in float32 end to end; the row sums (each over 4096 components, up to 4000 in magnitude) by 3.2e-6 and 1.9e-3 respectively. Tolerances: rows 7e-5 abs + 1e-5 rel (10x the float32 pipeline), sums 2e-2 abs + 1e-5 rel (10x); a banding bug gives O(1) errors.
